events.text: Meadow Friends
Ellie! Ellie! Wake up, sleepy elephant.
Good morning, Milo!
Good morning, Ellie! What a sunny day.
Shall we go and play in the meadow?
The meadow is full of friends today.
Yes please! Let's go.
Wait. Listen, Ellie. Do you hear that?
What was that?
I don't know. Let's go and find out!
Moo! Moo! Good morning, friends!
Look, Milo. It is Bella the cow.
Bella lives here in the big green field.
Hello Bella! What sound do you make?
I say moo! Moo! Moo!
Can you say moo with me?
Would you like to hear it one more time?
Moo! Moo!
Moo! Moo! That was wonderful.
Ellie, look! Down by the pond.
Quack! Quack! Hello everyone!
That is Pip the duck. Pip loves to swim.
Come and see my lovely blue pond!
Pip, what sound do you make?
I say quack! Quack, quack!
Can you say quack?
Quack! Quack! Very good!
Oh! Who said that?
Ribbit! Down here, on the lily pad!
Hello Hop! Hop is a little green frog.
I say ribbit! And I love to jump.
Frogs are wonderful jumpers.
Watch me go. Hop, hop, hop!
Can you jump and say ribbit?
Ribbit! Ribbit! Hooray!
Oh my! That was a very big sound.
Roar! Hello there. My name is Leo.
Do not worry, Milo. Leo is a friendly lion.
I say roar! But I am very gentle.
Can you roar like Leo?
Would you like to try a big roar?
Roar! What a brave sound!
Let us all make our sounds together!
One, two, three... everybody!
Moo!
Quack!
Ribbit!
Roar!
Squeak, squeak!
And the elephant says toot, toot!
Thank you for playing with us today.
You did so well today. Well done!
Come back soon. Goodbye, friends!
Bye bye!
